import math
import transactions = "./transactions.qui"

string[] names()
    return ["recency", "frequency", "monetary", "basket", "categories", "tenure"]

bool root_feature(int feature)
    return 1 <= feature <= 3

real64[] transform(real64[] values)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#values))[] then if root_feature(i) then math.sqrt(values[i]) else values[i]]

class Customer(string id, transactions.Order[] orders, local int reference_day)
    int recency := reference_day - [for order := orders[] then order.day].max()
    frequency := int(#orders)
    int spend := [for order := orders[] then order.net].sum()
    monetary := real64(spend) / 100.0
    basket := monetary / real64(frequency)
    category_spend := map<string, int>()
    for order := orders[]
        for row := order.rows[]
            .category_spend.set(row.category, transactions.lookup(category_spend, row.category) + row.amount)
    int categories := [for amount := category_spend.values()[] if amount > 0 then 1].sum()
    int tenure := reference_day - [for order := orders[] then order.day].min()
    raw := [real64(recency), real64(frequency), monetary, basket, real64(categories), real64(tenure)]
    transformed := transform(raw)

Customer[] eligible_customers(transactions.Order[] orders, int day)
    map<string, int> eligible
    for order := orders[]
        if order.net > 0
            .eligible.set(order.customer, 1)
    Customer[] customers := []
    for id := eligible.keys().sorted()[]
        purchases := [for order := orders[] if order.net > 0 and order.customer == id then order]
        customers = customers.append(Customer(id, purchases, day))
    return customers

real64 mean(real64[] values)
    return values.sum() / real64(#values)

real64 sample_sd(real64[] values)
    differences := values - mean(values)
    return math.sqrt((differences * differences).sum() / real64(int(#values) - 1))

class Scale(real64 raw_mean, real64 raw_sd, real64 mean_value, real64 deviation)

Scale[] fit_scaling(Customer[] customers)
    Scale[] scaling := []
    for: feature < 6
        raw := [for customer := customers[] then customer.raw[feature]]
        transformed := [for customer := customers[] then customer.transformed[feature]]
        scaling = scaling.append(Scale(mean(raw), sample_sd(raw), mean(transformed), sample_sd(transformed)))
    return scaling

real64[] standardize(real64[] values, Scale[] scaling)
    return [for feature := (0:<int(#values))[] then if scaling[feature].deviation == 0.0 then 0.0 else (values[feature] - scaling[feature].mean_value) / scaling[feature].deviation]

real64 correlation(real64[][] points, int first, int second)
    return [for point := points[] then point[first] * point[second]].sum() / real64(int(#points) - 1)

real64 squared_distance(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    differences := first - second
    return (differences * differences).sum()

real64[] mean_point(real64[][] points)
    return [for feature := points[0].indices()[] then [for point := points[] then point[feature]].sum() / real64(#points)]

int[][] groups(int[] labels, int k)
    int[] empty_members := []
    int[][] members := array(nat(k), fill = empty_members)
    for: i < int(#labels)
        members[labels[i]] = members[labels[i]].append(i)
    return members

real64[] cluster_center(real64[][] points, int[] labels, int label)
    return mean_point([for i := (0:<int(#points))[] if labels[i] == label then points[i]])

real64[][] cluster_centers(real64[][] points, int[] labels, int k)
    return [for label := (0:<k)[] then cluster_center(points, labels, label)]

class Assignment(int[] labels, real64[] errors)

Assignment assign(real64[][] points, real64[][] centers)
    int[] labels := []
    real64[] errors := []
    for point := points[]
        chosen := 0
        best := squared_distance(point, centers[0])
        for: 1 <= label < int(#centers)
            distance := squared_distance(point, centers[label])
            if distance < best
                chosen = label
                best = distance
        labels = labels.append(chosen)
        errors = errors.append(best)
    return Assignment(labels, errors)

int refill(Assignment &current, int k)
    sizes := array(nat(k), fill = 0)
    for label := current.labels[]
        sizes[label] += 1
    reseeds := 0
    for: label < k
        if sizes[label] != 0
            continue
        chosen := -1
        for: i < int(#current.labels)
            if sizes[current.labels[i]] >= 2 and (chosen < 0 or current.errors[i] > current.errors[chosen])
                chosen = i
        sizes[current.labels[chosen]] -= 1
        sizes[label] += 1
        current.labels[chosen] = label
        current.errors[chosen] = 0.0
        reseeds += 1
    return reseeds

real64 sse(real64[][] points, int[] labels, real64[][] centers)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#points))[] then squared_distance(points[i], centers[labels[i]])].sum()

class LloydResult(int[] labels, real64[][] centers, int iterations, int reseeds, bool converged, real64 within)

LloydResult lloyd(real64[][] points, real64[][] initial, int limit)
    k := int(#initial)
    current := assign(points, initial)
    iterations := 0
    reseeds := 0
    converged := false
    while iterations < limit
        reseeds += refill(&current, k)
        updated_centers := cluster_centers(points, current.labels, k)
        iterations += 1
        updated := assign(points, updated_centers)
        converged = updated.labels == current.labels
        current = updated
        if converged
            break
    reseeds += refill(&current, k)
    centers := cluster_centers(points, current.labels, k)
    return LloydResult(current.labels, centers, iterations, reseeds, converged, sse(points, current.labels, centers))

import math
import transactions = "./transactions.qui"
import features = "./features.qui"
import kmeans = "./kmeans.qui"
import validation = "./validation.qui"
import profiles = "./profiles.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

string yes_no(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

string[] blocks(string[][] sections)
    string[] lines := []
    for section := sections[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(section)
    return lines

int[] ordered_indices(real64[] values, descending := false)
    int[] order := []
    for: i < int(#values)
        position := int(#order)
        order = order.append(i)
        while position > 0
            previous := values[order[position - 1]]
            before := if descending then values[i] > previous else values[i] < previous
            if not before
                break
            order[position] = order[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        order[position] = i
    return order

class Generator(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
        return state

real64[] nearest_gaps(real64[][] points, int[] chosen)
    return [for point := points[] then [for index := chosen[] then kmeans.squared_distance(point, points[index])].min()]

int[] maximin(real64[][] points, int k, int restart)
    center := kmeans.mean_point(points)
    spreads := [for point := points[] then kmeans.squared_distance(point, center)]
    order := ordered_indices(spreads)
    chosen := [order[restart - 1]]
    while int(#chosen) < k
        gaps := nearest_gaps(points, chosen)
        selected := 0
        for: 1 <= i < int(#gaps)
            if gaps[i] > gaps[selected]
                selected = i
        chosen = chosen.append(selected)
    return chosen

int[] initial_indices(real64[][] points, int k, string method, int restart, Generator &generator)
    if method == "maximin"
        return maximin(points, k, restart)
    int[] chosen := []
    selected := array(#points, fill = false)
    if method == "forgy"
        while int(#chosen) < k
            index := .generator.draw() % int(#points)
            if not selected[index]
                selected[index] = true
                chosen = chosen.append(index)
        return chosen
    chosen = chosen.append(.generator.draw() % int(#points))
    while int(#chosen) < k
        gaps := nearest_gaps(points, chosen)
        weight := gaps.sum()
        threshold := (real64(.generator.draw()) / 2147483647.0) * weight
        real64 cumulative := 0.0
        index := -1
        for: i < int(#gaps)
            cumulative += gaps[i]
            if cumulative > threshold
                index = i
                break
        if index < 0
            for: i < int(#gaps)
                if gaps[i] > 0.0
                    index = i
        chosen = chosen.append(index)
    return chosen

class Refinement(int[] labels, int passes, int transfers, real64 within)

Refinement refine(real64[][] points, int[] original, int k, int limit)
    labels := original
    sizes := [for members := kmeans.groups(labels, k)[] then int(#members)]
    centers := kmeans.cluster_centers(points, labels, k)
    passes := 0
    transfers := 0
    while passes < limit
        changes := 0
        for: i < int(#points)
            own := labels[i]
            if sizes[own] == 1
                continue
            removal := (real64(sizes[own]) / real64(sizes[own] - 1)) * kmeans.squared_distance(points[i], centers[own])
            target := -1
            real64 cost := 0.0
            for: label < k
                if label == own
                    continue
                insertion := (real64(sizes[label]) / real64(sizes[label] + 1)) * kmeans.squared_distance(points[i], centers[label])
                if target < 0 or insertion < cost
                    target = label
                    cost = insertion
            if cost < removal
                labels[i] = target
                sizes[own] -= 1
                sizes[target] += 1
                centers[own] = kmeans.cluster_center(points, labels, own)
                centers[target] = kmeans.cluster_center(points, labels, target)
                changes += 1
                transfers += 1
        passes += 1
        if changes == 0
            break
    within := kmeans.sse(points, labels, kmeans.cluster_centers(points, labels, k))
    return Refinement(labels, passes, transfers, within)

class Run(string method, int restart, int[] seeds, local real64[][] points, local int limit)
    kmeans.LloydResult result := kmeans.lloyd(points, points[seeds], limit)
    Refinement improved := refine(points, result.labels, int(#seeds), limit)

class Solution(int k, local real64[][] points, local int[] original)
    int[][] members := kmeans.groups(original, k)
    for: 1 <= i < k
        current := members[i]
        position := i
        while position > 0
            previous := members[position - 1]
            before := #current > #previous or (#current == #previous and current[0] < previous[0])
            if not before
                break
            members[position] = previous
            position -= 1
        members[position] = current
    labels := array(#points, fill = 0)
    for: label < k
        for index := members[label][]
            labels[index] = label
    int[] sizes := [for group := members[] then int(#group)]
    real64[][] centers := kmeans.cluster_centers(points, labels, k)
    real64 within := kmeans.sse(points, labels, centers)

class Candidate(int k, Run[] runs, int[] method_bests, int best, Solution solution, local real64[][] points, local real64[][] distances, local profiles.Rule[] naming_rules)
    real64[] silhouettes := validation.silhouettes(distances, solution.labels, solution.sizes)
    real64 silhouette := features.mean(silhouettes)
    real64 calinski_harabasz := validation.calinski_harabasz(points, solution.centers, solution.sizes, solution.within)
    real64 davies_bouldin := validation.davies_bouldin(points, solution.labels, solution.centers, solution.sizes)
    real64 elbow_value := 0.0
    real64 hartigan_value := 0.0
    has_hartigan := false
    int[] rule_numbers := []
    string[] segment_names := []
    local used := array(#naming_rules, fill = 0)
    for center := solution.centers[]
        rule := profiles.rule_number(center, naming_rules)
        used[rule] += 1
        rule_numbers = rule_numbers.append(rule + 1)
        suffix := if used[rule] == 1 then "" else "_{used[rule]}"
        segment_names = segment_names.append(naming_rules[rule].name + suffix)

Candidate search(real64[][] points, int k, transactions.Params settings, profiles.Rule[] naming_rules, real64[][] distances, Generator &generator)
    Run[] runs := []
    int[] method_bests := []
    best := -1
    for method := settings.methods[]
        method_best := -1
        for: 1 <= restart <= settings.restarts
            seeds := initial_indices(points, k, method, restart, &generator)
            trial := Run(method, restart, seeds, points, settings.max_iterations)
            index := int(#runs)
            runs = runs.append(trial)
            if method_best < 0 or report.rounded_key(trial.improved.within) < report.rounded_key(runs[method_best].improved.within)
                method_best = index
        method_bests = method_bests.append(method_best)
        if best < 0 or report.rounded_key(runs[method_best].improved.within) < report.rounded_key(runs[best].improved.within)
            best = method_best
    solution := Solution(k, points, runs[best].improved.labels)
    return Candidate(k, runs, method_bests, best, solution, points, distances, naming_rules)

real64 gini(int[] spends)
    ordered := spends.sorted()
    count := int(#ordered)
    total := ordered.sum()
    weighted := [for i := (0:<count)[] then (i + 1) * ordered[i]].sum()
    return real64(2 * weighted - (count + 1) * total) / real64(count * total)

map<string, int> category_totals(features.Customer[] customers)
    map<string, int> totals
    for customer := customers[]
        for category := customer.category_spend.keys()[]
            .totals.set(category, transactions.lookup(totals, category) + transactions.lookup(customer.category_spend, category))
    return totals

string[] category_ranking(map<string, int> totals)
    positive := [for category := totals.keys().sorted()[] if transactions.lookup(totals, category) > 0 then category]
    real64[] amounts := [for category := positive[] then real64(transactions.lookup(totals, category))]
    return positive[ordered_indices(amounts, true)]

real64[][] subsample_jaccards(real64[][] points, Solution solution, transactions.Params settings, Generator &generator)
    count := int(#points)
    size := count * settings.subsample_percent / 100
    real64[] empty_values := []
    real64[][] values := array(nat(solution.k), fill = empty_values)
    for: replicate < settings.subsamples
        order := 0:<count
        for: i < size
            other := i + .generator.draw() % (count - i)
            saved := order[i]
            order[i] = order[other]
            order[other] = saved
        sample := order[0:<size].sorted()
        trial := kmeans.lloyd(points[sample], solution.centers, settings.max_iterations)
        for: segment < solution.k
            real64 best := 0.0
            for: label < solution.k
                both := 0
                either := 0
                for: i < size
                    member := solution.labels[sample[i]] == segment
                    assigned := trial.labels[i] == label
                    if member and assigned
                        both += 1
                    if member or assigned
                        either += 1
                if either > 0
                    best = math.max(best, real64(both) / real64(either))
            values[segment] = values[segment].append(best)
    return values

class Study(transactions.Params settings, transactions.Data data, profiles.Rule[] rules, local Generator &run_generator)
    transactions.Order[] reference_orders := transactions.group_orders(data.rows, 1, settings.reference_day)
    features.Customer[] customers := features.eligible_customers(reference_orders, settings.reference_day)
    n := int(#customers)
    id_positions := map<string, int>()
    for: i < n
        .id_positions.set(customers[i].id, i)
    features.Scale[] scaling := features.fit_scaling(customers)
    real64[][] points := [for customer := customers[] then features.standardize(customer.transformed, scaling)]
    local distance_values := validation.distance_table(points)
    Candidate[] candidates := []
    for: settings.k_min <= count <= settings.k_max
        candidates = candidates.append(search(points, count, settings, rules, distance_values, &run_generator))
    for: i < int(#candidates)
        candidates[i].elbow_value = validation.elbow(candidates[i].k, settings.k_min, settings.k_max, candidates[i].solution.within, candidates[0].solution.within, candidates[-1].solution.within)
        if i + 1 < int(#candidates)
            candidates[i].has_hartigan = true
            candidates[i].hartigan_value = validation.hartigan(candidates[i].solution.within, candidates[i + 1].solution.within, n, candidates[i].k)
    criteria := ["elbow", "silhouette", "calinski_harabasz", "davies_bouldin", "hartigan"]
    int[] votes := []
    vote_counts := array(#candidates, fill = 0)
    for: criterion < 4
        chosen := if criterion == 0 then 1 else 0
        end := int(#candidates) - (if criterion == 0 then 1 else 0)
        for: chosen + 1 <= i < end
            current_metrics := [candidates[i].elbow_value, candidates[i].silhouette, candidates[i].calinski_harabasz, candidates[i].davies_bouldin]
            best_metrics := [candidates[chosen].elbow_value, candidates[chosen].silhouette, candidates[chosen].calinski_harabasz, candidates[chosen].davies_bouldin]
            value := report.rounded_key(current_metrics[criterion])
            previous := report.rounded_key(best_metrics[criterion])
            if (criterion == 3 and value < previous) or (criterion != 3 and value > previous)
                chosen = i
        votes = votes.append(chosen)
        vote_counts[chosen] += 1
    local hartigan_choice := int(#candidates) - 1
    for: i < int(#candidates) - 1
        if candidates[i].hartigan_value <= 10.0
            hartigan_choice = i
            break
    votes = votes.append(hartigan_choice)
    vote_counts[hartigan_choice] += 1
    chosen_index := 0
    for: 1 <= i < int(#candidates)
        if vote_counts[i] > vote_counts[chosen_index] or (vote_counts[i] == vote_counts[chosen_index] and report.rounded_key(candidates[i].silhouette) > report.rounded_key(candidates[chosen_index].silhouette))
            chosen_index = i
    Candidate final := candidates[chosen_index]
    int k := final.k
    real64[] customer_distances := []
    int[] other_segments := []
    real64[] other_distances := []
    int[][] rfm_scores := []
    string[] rfm_codes := []
    for: i < n
        int own := final.solution.labels[i]
        customer_distances = customer_distances.append(math.sqrt(kmeans.squared_distance(points[i], final.solution.centers[own])))
        other := -1
        real64 best_distance := 0.0
        for: segment < k
            if segment == own
                continue
            distance := kmeans.squared_distance(points[i], final.solution.centers[segment])
            if other < 0 or distance < best_distance
                other = segment
                best_distance = distance
        other_segments = other_segments.append(other)
        other_distances = other_distances.append(math.sqrt(best_distance))
        ranks := [0, 0, 0]
        for customer := customers[]
            if customer.recency > customers[i].recency
                ranks[0] += 1
            if customer.frequency < customers[i].frequency
                ranks[1] += 1
            if customer.spend < customers[i].spend
                ranks[2] += 1
        scores := 1 + 5 * ranks / n
        rfm_scores = rfm_scores.append(scores)
        rfm_codes = rfm_codes.append("{scores[0]}{scores[1]}{scores[2]}")
    int total_spend := [for customer := customers[] then customer.spend].sum()
    overall_categories := category_totals(customers)
    string[] category_names := overall_categories.keys().sorted()
    int[] segment_spends := []
    map<string, int>[] segment_categories := []
    string[][] category_rankings := []
    real64[] within_segments := []
    for: segment < k
        members := final.solution.members[segment]
        features.Customer[] group := customers[members]
        segment_spends = segment_spends.append([for customer := group[] then customer.spend].sum())
        totals := category_totals(group)
        segment_categories = segment_categories.append(totals)
        category_rankings = category_rankings.append(category_ranking(totals))
        within_segments = within_segments.append([for index := members[] then kmeans.squared_distance(points[index], final.solution.centers[segment])].sum())
    real64[][] jaccards := subsample_jaccards(points, final.solution, settings, &run_generator)

    string ids(int[] indices)
        return [for index := indices[] then customers[index].id].join(" ")

    string segment_numbers()
        return report.integers(1:k)

    string[] features_file()
        lines := ["customer,recency,frequency,monetary,basket,categories,tenure,z_recency,z_frequency,z_monetary,z_basket,z_categories,z_tenure"]
        for: i < n
            customer := customers[i]
            values := [customer.id, "{customer.recency}", "{customer.frequency}", report.amount(customer.spend), report.real_text(customer.basket), "{customer.categories}", "{customer.tenure}"]
            values = values.concat([for value := points[i][] then report.real_text(value)])
            lines = lines.append(values.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] runs_file()
        string[][] sections := []
        for candidate := candidates[]
            lines := ["k {candidate.k}"]
            for trial := candidate.runs[]
                result := trial.result
                improved := trial.improved
                lines = lines.append("run {trial.method} {trial.restart} seeds {ids(trial.seeds)} iterations {result.iterations} converged {yes_no(result.converged)} reseeds {result.reseeds} sse {report.real_text(result.within)} passes {improved.passes} transfers {improved.transfers} refined {report.real_text(improved.within)}")
            for index := candidate.method_bests[]
                trial := candidate.runs[index]
                lines = lines.append("best {trial.method} restart {trial.restart} sse {report.real_text(trial.improved.within)}")
            chosen := candidate.runs[candidate.best]
            lines = lines.append("chosen {chosen.method} restart {chosen.restart} sse {report.real_text(chosen.improved.within)}")
            lines = lines.append("sizes {report.integers(candidate.solution.sizes)}")
            sections = sections.append(lines)
        return blocks(sections)

    string[] selection_file()
        index_lines := ["indices"]
        names := ["segments"]
        stability := ["stability"]
        for: i < int(#candidates)
            candidate := candidates[i]
            hartigan_text := if candidate.has_hartigan then report.real_text(candidate.hartigan_value) else "-"
            index_lines = index_lines.append("k={candidate.k} sse {report.real_text(candidate.solution.within)} elbow {report.real_text(candidate.elbow_value)} silhouette {report.real_text(candidate.silhouette)} calinski_harabasz {report.real_text(candidate.calinski_harabasz)} davies_bouldin {report.real_text(candidate.davies_bouldin)} hartigan {hartigan_text}")
            labels := [for segment := (0:<candidate.k)[] then "{candidate.segment_names[segment]}:{candidate.solution.sizes[segment]}"]
            names = names.append("k={candidate.k} " + labels.join(" "))
            parts := ["k={candidate.k}"]
            for: first < int(#candidate.method_bests)
                left := candidate.runs[candidate.method_bests[first]]
                for: first + 1 <= second < int(#candidate.method_bests)
                    right := candidate.runs[candidate.method_bests[second]]
                    parts = parts.append("{left.method}:{right.method} {report.real_text(validation.adjusted_rand(left.improved.labels, right.improved.labels))}")
            parts = parts.append("final")
            for index := candidate.method_bests[]
                trial := candidate.runs[index]
                parts = parts.append("{trial.method} {report.real_text(validation.adjusted_rand(trial.improved.labels, candidate.solution.labels))}")
            following := if i + 1 < int(#candidates) then report.real_text(validation.adjusted_rand(candidate.solution.labels, candidates[i + 1].solution.labels)) else "-"
            stability = stability.append(parts.append("next {following}").join(" "))
        vote_lines := ["votes"]
        for: i < 5
            vote_lines = vote_lines.append("{criteria[i]} k={candidates[votes[i]].k}")
        vote_lines = vote_lines.append("chosen k={k} votes {vote_counts[chosen_index]}")
        return blocks([index_lines, vote_lines, names, stability])

    string recommendation(int index)
        int segment := final.solution.labels[index]
        for category := category_rankings[segment][]
            if transactions.lookup(customers[index].category_spend, category) <= 0
                return category
        return "-"

    string[] segments_file()
        lines := ["customer,segment,name,distance,other,other_distance,silhouette,recommend"]
        for: i < n
            int segment := final.solution.labels[i]
            lines = lines.append("{customers[i].id},{segment + 1},{final.segment_names[segment]},{report.real_text(customer_distances[i])},{other_segments[i] + 1},{report.real_text(other_distances[i])},{report.real_text(final.silhouettes[i])},{recommendation(i)}")
        return lines

    string related(int[] members, int neighbor)
        if neighbor < settings.k_min or neighbor > settings.k_max
            return "k={neighbor} -"
        int[] labels := candidates[neighbor - settings.k_min].solution.labels
        counts := array(nat(neighbor), fill = 0)
        for index := members[]
            counts[labels[index]] += 1
        best := 0
        for: 1 <= label < neighbor
            if counts[label] > counts[best]
                best = label
        return "k={neighbor} segment {best + 1} shared {counts[best]}"

    string[] profile_lines(int segment)
        members := final.solution.members[segment]
        features.Customer[] group := customers[members]
        size := int(#members)
        center := final.solution.centers[segment]
        spend := segment_spends[segment]
        lines := ["segment {segment + 1} {final.segment_names[segment]} rule {final.rule_numbers[segment]} size {size} share {report.real_text(real64(size) / real64(n))} revenue {report.amount(spend)} revenue_share {report.real_text(real64(spend) / real64(total_spend))}"]
        lines = lines.append("  center " + report.reals(center))
        original := profiles.original_scale(center, scaling)
        feature_names := features.names()
        values := [for feature := (0:<6)[] then "{feature_names[feature]} {report.real_text(original[feature])}"]
        lines = lines.append("  value " + values.join(" "))
        trait_order := ordered_indices(math.abs(center), true)
        traits := [for feature := trait_order[0:<2][] then (if center[feature] > 0.0 then "high_" else "low_") + feature_names[feature]]
        lines = lines.append("  traits " + traits.join(" "))
        median_index := (size - 1) / 2
        recency := ([for customer := group[] then customer.recency].sorted())[median_index]
        frequency := ([for customer := group[] then customer.frequency].sorted())[median_index]
        monetary := ([for customer := group[] then customer.spend].sorted())[median_index]
        basket := ([for customer := group[] then customer.basket].sorted())[median_index]
        category_count := ([for customer := group[] then customer.categories].sorted())[median_index]
        tenure := ([for customer := group[] then customer.tenure].sorted())[median_index]
        lines = lines.append("  median recency {recency} frequency {frequency} monetary {report.amount(monetary)} basket {report.real_text(basket)} categories {category_count} tenure {tenure}")
        lines = lines.append("  related {related(members, k - 1)} {related(members, k + 1)}")
        top_order := ordered_indices([for customer := group[] then real64(customer.spend)], true)
        top_count := math.min(size, settings.top_customers)
        top := [for index := top_order[0:<top_count][] then "{group[index].id} {report.amount(group[index].spend)}"]
        lines = lines.append("  top_customers " + top.join(" "))
        real64[] gaps := []
        overdue := 0
        bins := array(#settings.order_bins + 1, fill = 0)
        gross := 0
        returned := 0
        cancelled := 0
        for customer := group[]
            if customer.frequency >= 2
                active_days := customer.tenure - customer.recency
                intervals := customer.frequency - 1
                gaps = gaps.append(real64(active_days) / real64(intervals))
                if customer.recency * intervals > settings.overdue_factor * active_days
                    overdue += 1
            for order := customer.orders[]
                bin_index := [for boundary := settings.order_bins[] if order.net >= boundary * 100 then 1].sum()
                bins[bin_index] += 1
            for order := reference_orders[]
                if order.customer != customer.id
                    continue
                if order.net <= 0
                    cancelled += 1
                for row := order.rows[]
                    if row.amount > 0
                        gross += row.amount
                    else
                        returned -= row.amount
        mean_gap := if #gaps == 0 then "-" else report.real_text(features.mean(gaps))
        lines = lines.append("  cadence customers {#gaps} mean_gap {mean_gap} overdue {overdue}")
        lines = lines.append("  order_sizes " + report.integers(bins))
        lines = lines.append("  sse {report.real_text(within_segments[segment])} share {report.real_text(within_segments[segment] / final.solution.within)}")
        lines = lines.append("  gini {report.real_text(gini([for features.Customer customer := group[] then customer.spend]))}")
        lines = lines.append("  returns rate {report.real_text(real64(returned) / real64(gross))} returned {report.amount(returned)} cancelled {cancelled}")
        real64[] silhouettes := final.silhouettes[members]
        negative := [for value := silhouettes[] if value < 0.0 then 1].sum()
        lines = lines.append("  silhouette {report.real_text(features.mean(silhouettes))} negative {negative}")
        scores := array(3, fill = 0)
        map<string, int> counts
        for index := members[]
            scores = scores + rfm_scores[index]
            .counts.set(rfm_codes[index], transactions.lookup(counts, rfm_codes[index]) + 1)
        codes := counts.keys().sorted()
        mode_index := 0
        for: 1 <= i < int(#codes)
            if transactions.lookup(counts, codes[i]) > transactions.lookup(counts, codes[mode_index])
                mode_index = i
        mode := codes[mode_index]
        lines = lines.append("  rfm r {report.real_text(real64(scores[0]) / real64(size))} f {report.real_text(real64(scores[1]) / real64(size))} m {report.real_text(real64(scores[2]) / real64(size))} mode {mode} {transactions.lookup(counts, mode)}")
        category_parts := ["  categories"]
        category_limit := math.min(int(#category_rankings[segment]), settings.top_categories)
        for category := category_rankings[segment][0:<category_limit][]
            share := real64(transactions.lookup(segment_categories[segment], category)) / real64(spend)
            lift := share / (real64(transactions.lookup(overall_categories, category)) / real64(total_spend))
            category_parts = category_parts.append("{category} {report.real_text(share)} {report.real_text(lift)}")
        lines = lines.append(category_parts.join(" "))
        string[] outliers := []
        if size >= 2
            real64[] distances := customer_distances[members]
            threshold := features.mean(distances) + settings.outlier_sd * features.sample_sd(distances)
            outliers = [for index := members[] if customer_distances[index] > threshold then customers[index].id]
        outlier_text := if #outliers == 0 then "" else " " + outliers.join(" ")
        return lines.append("  outliers {#outliers}{outlier_text}")

    string[] profiles_file()
        spends := [for customer := customers[] then customer.spend]
        string[][] sections := [["segments k={k} customers {n} revenue {report.amount(total_spend)} gini {report.real_text(gini(spends))}"]]
        for: segment < k
            sections = sections.append(profile_lines(segment))
        string[] mix := ["category_mix " + segment_numbers()]
        for category := category_names[]
            shares := [for segment := (0:<k)[] then real64(transactions.lookup(segment_categories[segment], category)) / real64(segment_spends[segment])]
            mix = mix.append(category + " " + report.reals(shares))
        string[] recency := ["rfm_recency " + segment_numbers()]
        for: 5 >= score >= 1
            counts := array(nat(k), fill = 0)
            for: i < n
                if rfm_scores[i][0] == score
                    counts[final.solution.labels[i]] += 1
            recency = recency.append("r={score} " + report.integers(counts))
        int[] code_labels := [for code := rfm_codes[] then int(code)]
        recency = recency.append("ari rfm_codes {report.real_text(validation.adjusted_rand(code_labels, final.solution.labels))}")
        center_lines := ["center_distances"]
        for: segment < k
            real64[] distances := [for center := final.solution.centers[] then math.sqrt(kmeans.squared_distance(final.solution.centers[segment], center))]
            center_lines = center_lines.append("{segment + 1} " + report.reals(distances))
        return blocks(sections.concat([mix, recency, center_lines]))

    string[] robustness_file()
        sample_size := n * settings.subsample_percent / 100
        subsamples := ["subsamples {settings.subsamples} size {sample_size}"]
        for: segment < k
            subsamples = subsamples.append("segment {segment + 1} {final.segment_names[segment]} mean_jaccard {report.real_text(features.mean(jaccards[segment]))} min_jaccard {report.real_text(jaccards[segment].min())}")
        ablation := ["ablation"]
        feature_names := features.names()
        for: feature < 6
            real64[][] reduced := [for point := points[] then point[0:<feature].concat(point[feature + 1:<#point])]
            seeds := maximin(reduced, k, 1)
            trial := Run("maximin", 1, seeds, reduced, settings.max_iterations)
            index := validation.adjusted_rand(trial.improved.labels, final.solution.labels)
            ablation = ablation.append("without {feature_names[feature]} seeds {ids(seeds)} iterations {trial.result.iterations} converged {yes_no(trial.result.converged)} transfers {trial.improved.transfers} sse {report.real_text(trial.improved.within)} ari {report.real_text(index)}")
        members := final.solution.members[0]
        real64[][] selected_points := points[members]
        selected_seeds := maximin(selected_points, 2, 1)
        split_run := Run("maximin", 1, selected_seeds, selected_points, settings.max_iterations)
        parts := Solution(2, selected_points, split_run.improved.labels)
        drilldown := [
            "drilldown segment 1 {final.segment_names[0]} size {#members} seeds {ids(members[selected_seeds])} iterations {split_run.result.iterations} converged {yes_no(split_run.result.converged)} transfers {split_run.improved.transfers}",
            "sse before {report.real_text(within_segments[0])} after {report.real_text(split_run.improved.within)} gain {report.real_text(within_segments[0] - split_run.improved.within)}"
        ]
        for: part < 2
            drilldown = drilldown.append("part {part + 1} size {parts.sizes[part]} center {report.reals(parts.centers[part])}")
        return blocks([subsamples, ablation, drilldown])

    string[] period_lines()
        lines := ["periods {settings.periods} days {settings.period_days}"]
        for: 1 <= period <= settings.periods
            first_day := settings.reference_day - period * settings.period_days + 1
            last_day := settings.reference_day - (period - 1) * settings.period_days
            revenues := array(nat(k), fill = 0)
            active := array(nat(k), fill = 0)
            acquired := array(nat(k), fill = 0)
            for: i < n
                int segment := final.solution.labels[i]
                used := false
                for order := customers[i].orders[]
                    if first_day <= order.day <= last_day
                        revenues[segment] += order.net
                        used = true
                if used
                    active[segment] += 1
                initial_day := settings.reference_day - customers[i].tenure
                if first_day <= initial_day <= last_day
                    acquired[segment] += 1
            revenue_text := [for cents := revenues[] then report.amount(cents)].join(" ")
            lines = lines.append("period {period} days {first_day} {last_day} revenue {revenue_text} active {report.integers(active)} acquired {report.integers(acquired)}")
        return lines

    string[] migration_lines()
        transactions.Order[] orders := transactions.group_orders(data.rows, 1, settings.snapshot_day)
        features.Customer[] snapshot := features.eligible_customers(orders, settings.snapshot_day)
        map<string, int> previous
        for customer := snapshot[]
            point := features.standardize(customer.transformed, scaling)
            assigned := kmeans.assign([point], final.solution.centers)
            .previous.set(customer.id, assigned.labels[0])
        int[][] counts := array(nat(k + 1), fill = array(nat(k), fill = 0))
        string[] moved := []
        stayed := 0
        fresh := 0
        lost := 0
        for: i < n
            int current := final.solution.labels[i]
            old := transactions.lookup(previous, customers[i].id, k)
            counts[old][current] += 1
            if old == k
                fresh += 1
            elif old == current
                stayed += 1
            else
                moved = moved.append("{customers[i].id} {old + 1} {current + 1}")
        for customer := snapshot[]
            if not id_positions.has(customer.id)
                lost += 1
        string[] lines := ["migration day {settings.snapshot_day} customers {#snapshot}", "from\to " + segment_numbers()]
        for: origin <= k
            label := if origin == k then "none" else "{origin + 1}"
            lines = lines.append(label + " " + report.integers(counts[origin]))
        lines = lines.append("moved_customers").concat(moved)
        return lines.append("stayed {stayed} moved {#moved} new {fresh} lost {lost}")

    string[] outcome_lines()
        first_day := settings.reference_day + 1
        last_day := settings.reference_day + settings.outcome_days
        transactions.Order[] orders := transactions.group_orders(data.rows, first_day, last_day)
        map<string, int> purchases
        for order := orders[]
            if order.net > 0
                .purchases.set(order.customer, transactions.lookup(purchases, order.customer) + order.net)
        lines := ["outcome days {first_day} {last_day}"]
        for: segment < k
            members := final.solution.members[segment]
            buyers := 0
            spend := 0
            for index := members[]
                if purchases.has(customers[index].id)
                    buyers += 1
                    spend += transactions.lookup(purchases, customers[index].id)
            size := int(#members)
            lines = lines.append("segment {segment + 1} {final.segment_names[segment]} size {size} buyers {buyers} rate {report.real_text(real64(buyers) / real64(size))} revenue {report.amount(spend)} per_customer {report.real_text((real64(spend) / 100.0) / real64(size))}")
        outsiders := 0
        outsider_spend := 0
        for id := purchases.keys()[]
            if not id_positions.has(id)
                outsiders += 1
                outsider_spend += transactions.lookup(purchases, id)
        return lines.append("unsegmented buyers {outsiders} revenue {report.amount(outsider_spend)}")

    string[] tracking_file()
        return blocks([period_lines(), migration_lines(), outcome_lines()])

    string[] data_lines()
        used := 0
        returned := 0
        later := 0
        for row := data.rows[]
            if row.day <= settings.reference_day
                used += 1
                if row.amount < 0
                    returned += 1
            else
                later += 1
        valid := [for order := reference_orders[] if order.net > 0 then 1].sum()
        excluded := [for id := data.customers[] if not id_positions.has(id) then id]
        excluded_text := if #excluded == 0 then "-" else excluded.join(" ")
        return [
            "rows {data.row_count} duplicates {data.duplicates} zero {data.zero} used {used} returns {returned} later {later}",
            "orders {#reference_orders} valid {valid} cancelled {int(#reference_orders) - valid}",
            "customers {#data.customers} clustered {n} excluded {#excluded}",
            "excluded_ids {excluded_text}"
        ]

    string[] category_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for category := category_names[]
            total := transactions.lookup(overall_categories, category)
            buyers := [for customer := customers[] if transactions.lookup(customer.category_spend, category) > 0 then 1].sum()
            lines = lines.append("category {category} revenue {report.amount(total)} share {report.real_text(real64(total) / real64(total_spend))} customers {buyers}")
        return lines

    string[] feature_summary_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        feature_names := features.names()
        for: feature < 6
            scale := scaling[feature]
            transform_name := if features.root_feature(feature) then "sqrt" else "none"
            lines = lines.append("feature {feature_names[feature]} transform {transform_name} raw_mean {report.real_text(scale.raw_mean)} raw_sd {report.real_text(scale.raw_sd)} mean {report.real_text(scale.mean_value)} sd {report.real_text(scale.deviation)}")
        return lines

    string[] correlation_lines()
        feature_names := features.names()
        lines := ["correlation " + feature_names.join(" ")]
        for: first < 6
            correlations := [for second := (0:<6)[] then features.correlation(points, first, second)]
            lines = lines.append(feature_names[first] + " " + report.reals(correlations))
        return lines

    string[] summary_file()
        return blocks([data_lines(), category_lines(), feature_summary_lines(), correlation_lines()])

void run()
    settings := transactions.Params(transactions.read_lines("input/params.txt"))
    data := transactions.read_data()
    profiles.Rule[] rules := profiles.read_rules()
    generator := Generator(settings.seed)
    study := Study(settings, data, rules, &generator)
    file.mkdir("output")
    report.write_lines("features.csv", study.features_file())
    report.write_lines("runs.txt", study.runs_file())
    report.write_lines("selection.txt", study.selection_file())
    report.write_lines("segments.csv", study.segments_file())
    report.write_lines("profiles.txt", study.profiles_file())
    report.write_lines("robustness.txt", study.robustness_file())
    report.write_lines("tracking.txt", study.tracking_file())
    report.write_lines("summary.txt", study.summary_file())

if main
    run()

import transactions = "./transactions.qui"
import features = "./features.qui"

class Condition(int feature, string comparison, real64 threshold)
    bool holds(real64[] center)
        return if comparison == ">" then center[feature] > threshold else center[feature] < threshold

class Rule(string name, Condition[] conditions)
    bool holds(real64[] center)
        for condition := conditions[]
            if not condition.holds(center)
                return false
        return true

Rule[] read_rules()
    Rule[] rules := []
    feature_names := features.names()
    for line := transactions.read_lines("input/segment_rules.txt")[]
        words := line.split(" ")
        Condition[] conditions := []
        for: 1 <= i < int(#words) step 3
            feature := 0
            while feature_names[feature] != words[i]
                feature += 1
            conditions = conditions.append(Condition(feature, words[i + 1], real64(words[i + 2])))
        rules = rules.append(Rule(words[0], conditions))
    return rules

int rule_number(real64[] center, Rule[] rules)
    for: i < int(#rules)
        if rules[i].holds(center)
            return i
    return -1

real64[] original_scale(real64[] center, features.Scale[] scaling)
    real64[] values := []
    for: i < int(#center)
        value := scaling[i].mean_value + scaling[i].deviation * center[i]
        values = values.append(if features.root_feature(i) then value * value else value)
    return values

import math

string real_text(real64 value)
    text := "{value:.4}"
    return if text == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" else text

string reals(real64[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then real_text(value)].join(" ")

int rounded_key(real64 value)
    rounded := math.round(value * 10000.0)
    return rounded

string amount(int cents)
    magnitude := math.abs(cents)
    whole := magnitude / 100
    fraction := magnitude % 100
    sign := if cents < 0 then "-" else ""
    padding := if fraction < 10 then "0" else ""
    return "{sign}{whole}.{padding}{fraction}"

string integers(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then "{value}"].join(" ")

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

int lookup(map<string, int> values, string key, fallback := 0)
    match values.get(key)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return fallback

string[] read_lines(string path)
    source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] lines := source_text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

string[] fields(string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    return words[1:<#words]

int first_integer(string line)
    return int(fields(line)[0])

class Params(local string[] lines)
    int reference_day := first_integer(lines[0])
    int snapshot_day := first_integer(lines[1])
    int outcome_days := first_integer(lines[2])
    local bounds := fields(lines[3])
    k_min := int(bounds[0])
    k_max := int(bounds[1])
    string[] methods := fields(lines[4])
    int restarts := first_integer(lines[5])
    int max_iterations := first_integer(lines[6])
    int seed := first_integer(lines[7])
    int subsamples := first_integer(lines[8])
    int subsample_percent := first_integer(lines[9])
    outlier_sd := real64(fields(lines[10])[0])
    int overdue_factor := first_integer(lines[11])
    int[] order_bins := [for value := fields(lines[12])[] then int(value)]
    int top_categories := first_integer(lines[13])
    int top_customers := first_integer(lines[14])
    int period_days := first_integer(lines[15])
    int periods := first_integer(lines[16])

class Row(local string line)
    local columns := line.split(",")
    string customer := columns[0]
    day := int(columns[1])
    string order_id := columns[2]
    string category := columns[3]
    amount := int(columns[4])

class Data(Row[] rows, string[] customers, int row_count, int duplicates, int zero)
class Order(string order_id, string customer, int day, int net, Row[] rows)

Data read_data()
    lines := read_lines("input/transactions.csv")
    Row[] rows := []
    map<string, int> seen
    map<string, int> customers
    duplicates := 0
    zero := 0
    for line := lines[1:<#lines][]
        row := Row(line)
        .customers.set(row.customer, 1)
        if seen.has(line)
            duplicates += 1
        elif row.amount == 0
            zero += 1
        else
            rows = rows.append(row)
        .seen.set(line, 1)
    return Data(rows, customers.keys().sorted(), int(#lines) - 1, duplicates, zero)

Order[] group_orders(Row[] rows, int first_day, int last_day)
    Order[] orders := []
    map<string, int> positions
    for row := rows[]
        if first_day <= row.day <= last_day
            index := lookup(positions, row.order_id, -1)
            if index < 0
                index = int(#orders)
                .positions.set(row.order_id, index)
                orders = orders.append(Order(row.order_id, row.customer, row.day, 0, []))
            if row.day < orders[index].day
                orders[index].day = row.day
            orders[index].net += row.amount
            orders[index].rows = orders[index].rows.append(row)
    return orders

import math
import kmeans = "./kmeans.qui"

real64[][] distance_table(real64[][] points)
    real64[][] distances := array(#points, fill = array(#points, fill = 0.0))
    for: i < int(#points)
        for: i + 1 <= j < int(#points)
            value := math.sqrt(kmeans.squared_distance(points[i], points[j]))
            distances[i][j] = value
            distances[j][i] = value
    return distances

real64[] silhouettes(real64[][] distances, int[] labels, int[] sizes)
    k := int(#sizes)
    real64[] values := []
    for: i < int(#labels)
        own := labels[i]
        if sizes[own] == 1
            values = values.append(0.0)
            continue
        real64[] totals := array(nat(k), fill = 0.0)
        for: j < int(#labels)
            if j != i
                totals[labels[j]] += distances[i][j]
        inner := totals[own] / real64(sizes[own] - 1)
        outer := [for label := (0:<k)[] if label != own then totals[label] / real64(sizes[label])].min()
        largest := math.max(inner, outer)
        values = values.append(if largest == 0.0 then 0.0 else (outer - inner) / largest)
    return values

real64 calinski_harabasz(real64[][] points, real64[][] centers, int[] sizes, real64 within)
    overall := kmeans.mean_point(points)
    between := [for label := (0:<int(#centers))[] then real64(sizes[label]) * kmeans.squared_distance(centers[label], overall)].sum()
    return (between / real64(int(#centers) - 1)) / (within / real64(int(#points) - int(#centers)))

real64 davies_bouldin(real64[][] points, int[] labels, real64[][] centers, int[] sizes)
    k := int(#centers)
    real64[] spreads := array(nat(k), fill = 0.0)
    for: i < int(#points)
        spreads[labels[i]] += math.sqrt(kmeans.squared_distance(points[i], centers[labels[i]]))
    spreads = spreads / real64(sizes)
    real64[] maxima := []
    for: label < k
        real64[] ratios := [for other := (0:<k)[] if other != label then (spreads[label] + spreads[other]) / math.sqrt(kmeans.squared_distance(centers[label], centers[other]))]
        maxima = maxima.append(ratios.max())
    return maxima.sum() / real64(k)

real64 elbow(int k, int first_k, int last_k, real64 within, real64 first, real64 last)
    x := real64(k - first_k) / real64(last_k - first_k)
    y := (within - last) / (first - last)
    return ((1.0 - x) - y) / math.sqrt(real64(2.0))

real64 hartigan(real64 within, real64 following, int count, int k)
    return (within / following - 1.0) * real64(count - k - 1)

real64 adjusted_rand(int[] first, int[] second)
    sx := 0
    sy := 0
    shared := 0
    for: i < int(#first)
        for: i + 1 <= j < int(#first)
            same_first := first[i] == first[j]
            same_second := second[i] == second[j]
            if same_first
                sx += 1
            if same_second
                sy += 1
            if same_first and same_second
                shared += 1
    count := int(#first)
    total := count * (count - 1) / 2
    numerator := 2 * (total * shared - sx * sy)
    denominator := total * (sx + sy) - 2 * sx * sy
    return if denominator == 0 then 1.0 else real64(numerator) / real64(denominator)
